book.name: Jon
book.title: Jon Jisas Krais Manö Aij u Jon kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Jisas nɨpe ñɨg yabɨƚ u gö ñɨg wain la

Ñɨn mɨhöp mɨdöm, bɨ ap nɨbi udnɨg göm, nɨbi bɨ wɨñ alö amöm, nan ñɨŋla Kena daun, ram mɨnöŋ Galili aŋ au. Ñɨn anɨbu, Jisas abe, bɨ nɨpe gau abe, kalɨp u rö nöp wɨñ alla arla. Pen Jisas nɨme abe am ram anɨbu mɨdeia.
Ñɨg wain u ñɨŋ hakeila, Jisas nɨme apöm Jisas nɨp haga, “Wain u ñɨŋ hakpal,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia, Jisas haga, “Yɨp anɨg gɨ anɨg gɨ, a gɨmön, yɨp hagagmön. Ñɨn yad u auagöp,” a ga.
Hageia, nɨme nɨpe am bɨ wög gɨ ñeb gau kalɨp haga, “Jisas manö ap hagainɨm, hagnɨm rö nöp gɨmim,” a ga.

Pen Juda nɨbi bɨ kabö udöm gɨpal rin kub yabɨƚ unbö kagoƚ jɨŋ u ud lɨlö mɨdeia. Rin kub añɨ añɨ ñɨg lida unbö ñɨnjuöl mamɨd u mɨl dap lep. Pen Juda nɨbi bɨ nagɨ adö kale gɨmɨdal rö, God amgö ilö nɨbi bɨ uɫ aij mɨdaiun, a göm, rin anɨb gau ñɨg mɨl dap hoŋ göm, ñɨn ma lɨ yumɨdal.
Jisas pen, bɨ wög gɨ ñeb gau kalɨp haga, “Kabö rin gai i, ñɨg mɨl dapim hoŋ gɨpe, ajmaŋ raunɨm,” a ga. Hageia, haga rö geila haga,
“Mɨñi ñɨg mɨl dap lɨbim u, mɨl dammim, bɨ nan ñɨŋabun i abad mɨdöp u nɨp ñɨmim,” a ga.

Hageia, ñɨg yabɨƚ anɨbu mɨl dam bɨ kub u nɨp ñeila, nɨpe udöm ñɨŋ nɨŋa, ñɨg wain aij u mɨdeia. Pen nɨpe ñɨg wain anɨbu gai nɨbö göm nɨŋaga; bɨ wög gɨ ñeb gau kale nöp nɨŋla. Pen nɨpe nɨŋaga rö me, bɨ nɨbi udnɨg ga anɨbu nɨp wɨñ alö aueia haga,
“Pör nöp, ñɨg wain aij u nöd dap ñɨlö ñɨŋ haklö me, hainö ñɨg wain naij u ñɨlö ñɨŋbal. Pen ne ñɨg wain aij u dap lö mɨdajɨp, mɨñi nöp dap ñabön,” a ga.
Jisas nan gagep nöd nɨbö ga anɨbu, nɨpe Kena daun, ram mɨnöŋ Galili aŋ au mɨdöm ga. Nan gagep anɨbu göm, nɨpe aige bɨ rö mɨdeia u yamö bɨ nɨpe gau nɨŋöm, nɨp nɨŋ udla.
Pen Kena daun arö göm, Jisas nɨpe ke, nɨme, nɨmam hain, bɨ nɨpe gau aip daun pro Kapaneam amöm, yöp ñɨn bad ap anɨb au mɨdeila.
God sabe gep ram u nan sɨkim geila, Jisas kalɨp rɨdɨk gɨ höŋ yaŋ yua
Juda kai Pasopa ñɨn kub kale u söl ga nɨŋöm Jisas Jerusalem ara.
Jisas Jerusalem amöm, God sabe gep ram raul u nɨŋa, bɨ rɨmnap kale kaj kau, kaj sipsip, yaur dapo gau dap sɨkim göm, bɨ rɨmnap abañ bad gau löm, mab po adö asɨköm, mani yɨmjɨköm geila.
Jisas nɨŋöm, nagɨ ap udöm malɨköm, kaj sipsip kaj kau gau rɨdɨk gɨ höŋ yaŋ yuöm, mani dap pen pen yɨmjɨköm geila abañ bad gau mani halö ud hoŋ gɨ yua.
Anɨg göm, nɨbi bɨ yaur dapo dap sɨkim geila gau kalɨp haga, “Nan anɨb gau ud arim. Bapi yad ram nɨpe u gɨpe sɨkim ram rö lagnɨm,” a ga.
Jisas anɨg geia, bɨ nɨpe gau gasɨ kale ara God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla manö ap adö u. Manö anɨbu kalɨ kƚiñ rɨköm hagla, “Sabe gep ram ne u mɨdmagö yabɨƚ lem umnabin,” a gɨla.
Pen Juda bɨ kub rɨmnap apöm, Jisas nɨp hag nɨŋöm hagla, “Nöp an hagajɨp apön anɨg gabön? God nöp hagö apem gabin a gɨmön, nan gagep rö ap gö nɨŋun, ‘Nɨŋö hagpan,’ a gun,” a gɨla.
Anɨg hageila, Jisas kalɨp pen haga, “Kale God sabe gep ram anɨbi rɨb waƚ geinabim, ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ kauyaŋ gɨ lɨnabin,” a ga.
Anɨg hageia hagla, “God sabe gep ram anɨbi, mɨ ñɨnjuöl mɨhöp ado gɨ da unbö kagoƚ jɨŋ (46) gɨ hakla u pen ne ñɨn mɨhau nɨgaŋ kauyaŋ gɨ lɨnabin a gan ar?” a gɨla.
Pen Jisas nɨpe sabe gep ram manö haga anɨbu, hañ romaŋ nɨpe ke nöp haga.
Anɨb u me, hainö Jisas nɨpe umöm uraka u, bɨ nɨp hain gɨmɨdal gau God Manö u abe, Jisas nɨpe ke manö haga anɨbu abe gasɨ nɨŋöm, “Nɨŋö hagöp,” a göm nɨŋ udla.
Jisas nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö nɨŋöb
Jisas, Juda kai Pasopa ñɨn kub kale u Jerusalem mɨdöm, nan gagep rö rɨmnap geia u nɨŋöm, nɨbi bɨ gau, “Nɨpe nöp Mesaia u,” a göm nɨp nɨŋ udla.
Pen Jisas nɨbi bɨ gɨpal adö u ke nɨŋ aij göp rö, nɨbi bɨ anɨb gau gasɨ kale adö mai araia u nɨŋ aij ga u me, nɨpe kalɨp nɨbi bɨ nɨŋeb yad gau a göm udaga.
